description: Read an integer VND amount in Vietnamese words, e.g. 1200000 -> "một triệu hai trăm nghìn đồng". Also reads plain numbers without a unit with plain: true, e.g. 30 -> "ba mươi". Options: thousand "nghìn"/"ngàn", odd "lẻ"/"linh", capitalize, unit.

plain.description: Read a plain number without a unit (default false); not with unit/chan

name: vn_money_to_words
title: Amount in Vietnamese words
